entries.name: umt
entries.description: Connect 28 production-ready MCP servers to any coding agent. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/): three zero-config stdio servers out of the box (Hacker News, arXiv, npm registry, each pinned to an exact npm version), plus the umt-mcp skill that drives the umt CLI to wire any of the 28 servers into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and more. Needs Node.js and npm on PATH.

entries.name: usage-stats
entries.description: Multi-provider usage/balance for the Hermes Desktop status bar — shows live usage for OpenCode, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, NovitaAI, ZAI, Alibaba, Arcee, plus gateway-native Claude/Codex/Cursor/Nous.

entries.name: vaultwarden
entries.description: Vaultwarden / Bitwarden Password Manager (bw CLI) secret source

entries.name: voice-call-timeout
entries.description: Configurable Discord voice-call inactivity timeout for Hermes Agent.

entries.name: volcengine-voice
entries.description: Volcengine (火山引擎) Doubao TTS & STT provider for Hermes Agent — 60+ Chinese voices, dialect support, speaker diarization

entries.name: watchline
entries.description: Watchline delivery adapter for Hermes Agent. Polls a Watchline pull channel and forwards matched events into the Hermes gateway as inbound messages.

entries.name: weather
entries.description: Weather data, radar/model imagery, and verified meteorological calculations. Built on metrust, rusbie, wrf-rust, rustdar, and ecape-rs.

entries.name: web-defuddle
entries.description: Defuddle content extraction — local, free, no API key. Shells out to the defuddle CLI for clean article markdown. Extract-only; pair with SearXNG or another search provider.

entries.name: web-octen
entries.description: Octen web search with query-focused highlights and page extraction.

entries.name: web-ollama-cloud
entries.description: Ollama Cloud web search + content extraction via Ollama's native REST API. Search returns web results; extract fetches page content. Reuses OLLAMA_API_KEY (https://ollama.com/settings/keys).

entries.name: web-oxylabs
entries.description: Oxylabs AI Studio web search and extraction provider for Hermes Agent. Requires OXYLABS_API_KEY (sign up at https://aistudio.oxylabs.io/api-key).

entries.name: web-search-plus
entries.description: Multi-provider web search, URL extraction, quality reports, and opt-in research mode

entries.name: web-serply
entries.description: Serply web search provider for Hermes Agent. Google web results via the Serply SERP API. Requires SERPLY_API_KEY (sign up at https://serply.io).

entries.name: web-venice
entries.description: Venice AI web search + extract — privacy-first, zero data retention, $0.01/request.

entries.name: yantrikdb-hermes-dashboard
entries.description: Local-only YantrikDB dashboard for Hermes Agent memory operations

entries.name: yantrikdb
entries.description: YantrikDB — self-maintaining memory for Hermes with canonicalization, contradiction tracking, recency-aware ranking, explainable recall, and pluggable embedders (bundled potion-2M default; first-class loaders for the model2vec family and the HF sentence-transformers ecosystem; custom Python embedder

entries.name: you
entries.description: You.com skills for live web search, URL content extraction, cited research, finance research, and integration discovery via the You.com MCP servers (api.you.com). Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/, five skills bundled); auth via YDC_API_KEY, OAuth, or MPP/x402 — the free profile works keyless.

entries.name: zerosignal
entries.description: ZeroSignal — private, pay-per-request inference through the local zs-proxy; no API key, your wallet is the credential.
